eight_expert.note: Eight experts, three protected tasks, seven complete test datasets; TA coefficient 0.2. AGA processes only the protected expert. EuroSAT is excluded; no eight-task mean. Partner losses remain in the table.

attacks.note: Two experts, TA coefficient 0.5. TA uses no recovery; AGA processes the protected expert. Calib. uses 64 fixed random images for output calibration. MLP matching uses public weights. Distill. denotes hard-label student training on extra unlabeled images; ProDistill is reported separately. Defense 1 and PaRaMS share the unprotected student because their teacher labels coincide. Higher standalone accuracy and lower merged accuracy favor protection.

partners.note: Two experts, TA coefficient 0.5. TA uses no recovery; AGA processes the protected expert. Calib. uses 64 fixed random images for output calibration. MLP matching uses public weights. Distill. denotes hard-label student training on extra unlabeled images; ProDistill is reported separately. Defense 1 and PaRaMS share the unprotected student because their teacher labels coincide. These are partner accuracies, not protection scores.

feature_distillation.note: Two-expert adaptation of the fixed author coefficient kernel. The attacker uses 64 unlabeled training images per task, task identity, and 100 epochs per block. Initial coefficient 0.3; no AGA preprocessing. Final LayerNorm and projection are not optimized. Defense 1 reuses identical unprotected blocks. Lower target accuracy favors protection; partner accuracy is reported separately. Standalone accuracy is reported in the main attack table.

defense2_versions.note: The earlier and updated Defense 2 releases use distinct frozen construction rules; each row uses one release throughout. TA coefficient 0.5; AGA processes the protected expert. Calibration uses 64 random images. ProDistill uses 64 unlabeled training images per task and coefficient initialization 0.3, with no AGA preprocessing. MNIST is paired with SVHN; SVHN and DTD are paired with MNIST. Known-module replacement is reported separately; neither version resists it.

defense2_version_partners.note: The earlier and updated Defense 2 releases use distinct frozen construction rules; each row uses one release throughout. TA coefficient 0.5; AGA processes the protected expert. Calibration uses 64 random images. ProDistill uses 64 unlabeled training images per task and coefficient initialization 0.3, with no AGA preprocessing. MNIST is paired with SVHN; SVHN and DTD are paired with MNIST. Known-module replacement is reported separately; neither version resists it.

defense2_eight_versions.note: The same earlier and updated releases as the two-expert version tables. Eight experts, TA coefficient 0.2; AGA processes only the protected expert. Seven complete test datasets, including all evaluated partner tasks. Unprotected weights and scores match between versions. EuroSAT is excluded; no eight-task mean. Lower protected-task accuracy favors protection; losses on other tasks are reported without averaging.

defense2_eight_calibration.note: Same frozen updated Defense 2 releases; eight experts, TA coefficient 0.2. AGA processes the protected expert. Each merged model is calibrated independently using 64 fixed random images and its public classifier, without real images, labels or changed-module knowledge. Full archived scores are reused. Seven complete datasets; EuroSAT is excluded, and no eight-task mean is reported.

defense2_eight_calibration_target.note: Same frozen updated Defense 2 releases; eight experts, TA coefficient 0.2. AGA processes the protected expert. Each merged model is calibrated independently using 64 fixed random images and its public classifier, without real images, labels or changed-module knowledge. Full archived scores are reused. Seven complete datasets; EuroSAT is excluded, and no eight-task mean is reported.

eight_calibration_target.note: Eight experts, TA coefficient 0.2; AGA processes the protected expert. Each merged model uses the same 64 fixed random inputs for output calibration. No real attack images, clean target expert, or changed-module knowledge is used. Defense 2 denotes the updated release throughout; standalone accuracy is measured before merging. Seven complete test datasets; EuroSAT is excluded, and no eight-task mean is reported.

eight_calibration.note: Eight experts, TA coefficient 0.2; AGA processes the protected expert. Each merged model uses the same 64 fixed random inputs for output calibration. No real attack images, clean target expert, or changed-module knowledge is used. Defense 2 denotes the updated release throughout; standalone accuracy is measured before merging. Seven complete test datasets; EuroSAT is excluded, and no eight-task mean is reported.

defense2_mergers.note: Same updated releases as the TA and recovery tables. Two experts; MNIST is paired with SVHN, SVHN and DTD with MNIST. Fixed author TIES kernel: top 20 percent, coefficient 1.0. DARE+TA: drop rate 0.2, seed 42, coefficient 0.5. No AGA preprocessing or parameter search. Complete test sets; matching unprotected scores and standalone scores reused after parameter-hash checks. TIES and DARE are merging algorithms, not additional recovery attacks.

defense2_projection.note: Fixed component comparison of the current Defense 2. Only the two task-SVD constraints on A are removed; synthetic inputs, bias compensation, functional bound, optimizer and stopping rules are unchanged. Task-shaped synthetic probes are retained. Two experts, TA coefficient 0.5; AGA-t processes the protected expert, AGA-b both experts. Calibration uses the same 64 random inputs. All three controls are frozen before real-image evaluation. MNIST and SVHN controls stop with nonzero synthetic classification violations; DTD reaches zero. All controls are reported, including these failures. No task-wise replacement of the main method or proof of improved performance on other datasets.

defense2_projection_partners.note: Fixed component comparison of the current Defense 2. Only the two task-SVD constraints on A are removed; synthetic inputs, bias compensation, functional bound, optimizer and stopping rules are unchanged. Task-shaped synthetic probes are retained. Two experts, TA coefficient 0.5; AGA-t processes the protected expert, AGA-b both experts. Calibration uses the same 64 random inputs. All three controls are frozen before real-image evaluation. MNIST and SVHN controls stop with nonzero synthetic classification violations; DTD reaches zero. All controls are reported, including these failures. No task-wise replacement of the main method or proof of improved performance on other datasets. MNIST is paired with SVHN; SVHN and DTD with MNIST.

defense2_projection_recovery.note: The same fixed projection controls as the preceding ablation. MLP matching uses public weights without images. B reset replaces the last MLP output matrix and bias with the public base, requiring knowledge of the modified location; its unprotected control receives the same replacement. Both use TA coefficient 0.5. ProDistill uses 64 additional unlabeled training images per task, 100 epochs per block and coefficient initialization 0.3; no AGA preprocessing. Data, indices and training steps match the retained-projection comparison. These recovery conditions are separate, not one common attacker. Standalone columns precede recovery. MNIST and SVHN synthetic source-condition failures remain reported; no new defense updates.

defense2_projection_recovery_partners.note: The same fixed projection controls as the preceding ablation. MLP matching uses public weights without images. B reset replaces the last MLP output matrix and bias with the public base, requiring knowledge of the modified location; its unprotected control receives the same replacement. Both use TA coefficient 0.5. ProDistill uses 64 additional unlabeled training images per task, 100 epochs per block and coefficient initialization 0.3; no AGA preprocessing. Data, indices and training steps match the retained-projection comparison. These recovery conditions are separate, not one common attacker. Standalone columns precede recovery. MNIST and SVHN synthetic source-condition failures remain reported; no new defense updates. MNIST is paired with SVHN; SVHN and DTD with MNIST.

defense2_projection_eight.note: Eight experts participate in TA with coefficient 0.2. AGA processes the protected expert. Output calibration uses 64 random images. The removed condition drops the two projections used to construct A and keeps the task-specific synthetic inputs. Seven complete test sets are available. The original EuroSAT split is unverified.

defense2_projection_eight_datasets.note: Eight experts participate in TA with coefficient 0.2. AGA processes the protected expert. Output calibration uses 64 random images. The removed condition drops the two projections used to construct A and keeps the task-specific synthetic inputs. Seven complete test sets are available. The original EuroSAT split is unverified.

defense2_hard_label.note: TA coefficient 0.5. Additional unlabeled training images: MNIST and SVHN 2048 each, DTD train1 1880. The attacker trains a public-base student for 50 epochs using teacher class predictions, without ground-truth labels. The fixed images, seed, initialization, optimizer and training budget match the historical comparison. Historical students used an RTX 3090; new students used an RTX 4090 D. Small differences are not isolated causal effects of the teacher labels. MNIST reuses the same student because all 2048 teacher labels coincide. Standalone reports the evaluated student or expert. Defender weights are unchanged; additional real images are used only by the attacker.

prodistill_components.note: Complete test accuracy. Other parameters remain fixed at the trained ProDistill model. A and B include their respective biases. Initial values use the same 0.3 initialization; trained values come from one completed joint coefficient fit. These are fixed component substitutions, not separately trained A-only or B-only attacks. Both-trained scores are reused from the same frozen model. No new optimization.

defense2_components.note: Same current Defense 2 releases. A and B include their respective biases. A-only and B-only retain the selected changes without refitting. Gaussian perturbations match each of the four tensor-change norms, with one fixed seed. TA coefficient 0.5; AGA-T processes the protected expert and AGA-B both experts. Low merged accuracy is useful only alongside preserved standalone accuracy. No output calibration or distillation is added to these component comparisons.

defense2_component_partners.note: Same current Defense 2 releases. A and B include their respective biases. A-only and B-only retain the selected changes without refitting. Gaussian perturbations match each of the four tensor-change norms, with one fixed seed. TA coefficient 0.5; AGA-T processes the protected expert and AGA-B both experts. Low merged accuracy is useful only alongside preserved standalone accuracy. No output calibration or distillation is added to these component comparisons.

defense2_native_views.note: Two-expert TA at 0.5. AGA-T processes the target expert and AGA-B processes both. Calibration uses 64 random images. MNIST failed one source decision and stopped before natural evaluation.

defense2_native_means.note: Two-expert TA at 0.5. AGA-T processes the target expert and AGA-B processes both. Calibration uses 64 random images. All three constructions passed their source conditions. No main release is replaced.

unmask.note: Eight experts; TA and whole-publication subtraction coefficients are both 0.2. Paper-formula adaptation, not author code. Every protected prediction equals the equally processed unprotected prediction. Low accuracy also occurs without protection; it does not demonstrate a defense advantage. Seven complete test datasets; no eight-task mean.

params_composition.note: MNIST is protected; SVHN is the partner. TA coefficient 0.5. AGA-T processes the target; AGA-B processes both experts. ProDistill uses 64 additional unlabeled images per task and 100 epochs per block, with initial coefficient 0.3. Official default PaRaMS is applied to each frozen defense; construction uses no images.

params_composition_recovery.note: Extra knowledge: the modified location. Defense 1 uses final-bias projection; Defense 2 replaces the last MLP output weight and bias with public base values. Each control undergoes the same operation. AGA followed by module recovery is a composed procedure, separate from AGA alone. TA coefficient 0.5; no real attack data.
